summary: Draganfly Inc., a drone manufacturer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 1, 2026 press release announcing that the FAA granted a Section 44807 exemption for its Heavy Lift drone platform, permitting operations over the standard 55-pound weight limit. This is a regulatory approval, not a special situation. The filing contains no transaction, shareholder action, or structural change. It is an operational milestone with forward-looking statements. No special-situation category applies; the event is routine business progress. What to watch: customer adoption and revenue impact from heavy-lift operations.
